recording.sensor_format: Unmodified CARLA raw_data bytes, or JSON for IMU/GNSS; per-frame index includes type, dimensions, pose and timestamp.
recording.coordinates: Raw states and sensor files use CARLA metres and left-handed axes. ROS messages use right-handed x forward, y left, z up; camera optical frame x right, y down, z forward.
recording.replay: Use states.jsonl and original sensor files for exact captured values; carla.log is native actor replay, not bit-identical regenerated sensors.

recovery_operation.detail: Saved configuration restored and paused; actor IDs and simulation time may differ

startup_reproducibility: Fresh owned process and seeded actors; episode time before synchronous connection can vary
resource_policy: Measured profile when available; otherwise estimated sensor cost

signal_audit.scope: Movement-entry boundary observations and protected-conflict checks; yielding requires dedicated interaction tests

performance.world_includes: Physics, actor ticks, Traffic Manager, replication and RPC; not pure physics time

gpu_operation.detail: 4 GPU workers ready; sensor frames verified

sensor_files.name: roof_lidar
sensor_files.coordinates: Raw points are in the sensor frame at each firing; time_offset is relative to scan_start. Deskew before treating the cloud as one rigid frame.
